hints.title: Run Decomposition
hints.text: Segment the entire array into maximal strictly increasing contiguous runs.

hints.title: Intra-Run Contribution
hints.text: Within any single run of length L, two adjacent increasing subarrays of length floor(L / 2) can be placed.

hints.title: Inter-Run Contribution
hints.text: Between two consecutive runs of length L_i and L_{i+1}, the maximum subarray length is min(L_i, L_{i+1}). The overall answer is the maximum over all runs and adjacent run pairs.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear decomposition into increasing run lengths followed by maximum calculation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Binary search on k with O(n) checking takes O(n log n), while run inspection is clean O(n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(n) auxiliary list storing run lengths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives the formula max(L_i // 2, min(L_i, L_{i+1})) over all adjacent run pairs in linear time.
